# Aktierna vi köper i frossan

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Dagens Industri's 'Kort och lång' (Robert Andersson and Ulf Pettersson) covers a turbulent week. The US midterm elections were followed by a sharp sell-off in AI hardware and semiconductor stocks, Riksbanken made its first rate hike of the cycle, inflation came in lower than expected and oil fell sharply. The hosts lean towards taking cover rather than buying the dip. They avoid AI hardware and the Swedish industrials exposed to data centres, and prefer software (Addnode, Karnov, Vitec), property stocks such as Fabege as the most defensive choice, and European defence over US AI. Company coverage centres on strong reports from BTS and Yubico, where both hosts doubt the valuations, and Hemnet's surprise CEO dismissal. Both hosts end the episode short on the Stockholm index.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Ulf does not want to own AI hardware despite P/E falling to 11; chip prices are at unsustainable bottleneck levels.

#### Reasoning

Hardware vendors' earnings rest on chip prices that rose about sixfold; a halving of prices would leave them barely profitable. Political resistance after the Democratic midterm gains could slow the data-centre build-out, so the low P/E on peak earnings is misleading.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the AI capex build-out pace re-accelerates
- if chip pricing proves sustainable

> *"Förvisso ska det sägas att multiplarna har kommit ner rejält. Nvidia hamnar på 11 gånger PE. Men jag vill inte äga hårdvarubolag."*

---

### ⛔ ABB — ABB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Data-centre-exposed industrials depend on continued build-out; order intake could weaken within two quarters.

#### Reasoning

Swedish and Swiss industrials with data-centre exposure need the build-out pace to keep rising, not just stay flat. Slower data-centre construction under Democratic political pressure, especially in Texas, could hit ABB's order intake within two quarters.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre orders keep growing in coming reports

> *"Men det kan vara så att orderingång för ABB är superkass redan om två kvartal."*

---

### ⛔ ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Grouped with ABB as data-centre-exposed industrials where caution is warranted.

#### Reasoning

Atlas Copco's strong reports depend on data-centre build-out continuing to grow; a slowdown would hurt order intake. The hosts advise caution rather than an outright sell.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre order intake holds up

> *"Då kan man prata Atlas och ABB. Det har varit helt otroliga rapporter... Man ska vara försiktig."*

---

### 🟠 SKA-B — Skanska | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Good report, but a third of Q3 order intake was data centres, which is at risk under Democratic resistance in Texas.

#### Reasoning

A large share of Skanska's order intake is AI-related data-centre construction. Political headwinds could delay orders, so watch order intake.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre orders are postponed or cancelled

> *"Ta Skanska, det kom en bra rapport denna vecka. Men en tredjedel av deras orderingång för tredje kvartalet var datacenter."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Ulf has tipped it before, it has done well since, and probably has some potential left; software is preferred as protection against the AI-hardware sell-off.

#### Reasoning

Software stocks were hit hard by AI-disruption fears, and that risk has shrunk over recent days. In a rotation, not a full sell-off, software with moderate valuations acts as the 'small helmet' and should hold up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market turns into a full bear market where high P/E stocks fall most
- if AI disruption risk to software rises again

> *"Addnode har jag köptekat. Det har gått ganska bra sen dess. Det finns nog lite potential kvar."*

---

### 🟢 KAR — Karnov | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Suggested as a software buy after the AI-risk sell-off.

#### Reasoning

Karnov was among the software names hit by AI-disruption fears. With that risk easing and a rotation away from AI hardware, it is a candidate dip buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market moves to a broad sell-off
- if AI disruption risk increases

> *"Jag undrar om man inte ska kika på att köpa Karnov eller nån annan."*

---

### 🟢 VIT-B — Vitec | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Listed with Karnov and Addnode as software to buy if the market rotates rather than sells off.

#### Reasoning

Part of the software basket the hosts favour as moderate protection against an AI-hardware correction, provided there is rotation rather than total liquidation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the market moves to a full bear market

> *"Köper vi Krono, Ladnode eller Vitec tror du ändå på att vi har en rotation framför oss, inte nån total utförsäljning."*

---

### 🟢 FABG — Fabege | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

The full-protection choice: a property stock with no expectations priced in, which benefits if rates come down.

#### Reasoning

Traditional defensives such as telecoms and Axfood are highly priced, so for maximum protection the host would go to property. Fabege has performed poorly with no expectations priced in, and lower inflation may cap further rate hikes.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates rise more than expected
- if risk appetite returns strongly

> *"Fabege som har gått dåligt eller något sånt där. Men det beror på hur hårt, hur mycket skydd man ska ta."*

---

### 🟠 RHM — Rheinmetall | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 20% on a weak report; host 'maybe' buys the dip and is more positive than on Saab; European defence build-out seen as nearly impossible to slow.

#### Reasoning

The host prefers Rheinmetall's profitability and cash-flow profile over Saab's and is overweight Europe. Defence spending decisions are seen as locked in, but the host does not dare commit to buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- if European defence budgets are cut
- if a Ukraine peace deal reduces demand

> *"Jag vågar faktiskt inte säga om jag köper en elitmetall. Kanske. Jag är mer positiv till elitmetall än Saab."*

---

### ⛔ BTS-B — BTS Group | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Strong AI-driven quarter and stock up 20%, but P/E around 25 on growth that may be temporary; both hosts say 'more short than long'.

#### Reasoning

BTS benefits from technology shifts by teaching companies AI basics, which may be a short-lived demand wave. At about 25x P/E on growth whose structural nature is unproven, both hosts want to see more before buying, despite the strong 13% organic growth and high scalability.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI-driven growth proves structural over coming quarters

> *"Jag vet inte om jag vågar säga att jag är kort men jag är kanske mer kort än lång faktiskt"*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Very strong report (order intake up 85%, 29% organic growth) and AI-driven cyber threats are a tailwind, but the valuation is high; the November capital markets day is a key event.

#### Reasoning

Cybersecurity demand is structural and Yubico leads in physical security keys. The new 2031 targets (15-20% growth, 20% margin) imply the valuation is not cheap after a 250-300% rise. Hosts are torn; Ulf says one could regret not buying in 2026.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the capital markets day disappoints
- if digital keys displace physical keys
- if order momentum fades

> *"Jag ska hålla koll på Yubico. De har en kapitalmarknadsdag i november."*

---
